subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence to make it a meaningful sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.

A new kind of pollution that __is acquiring serious dimensions was noise pollution__.

options.text: have been acquiring serious dimensions is noise pollution.
is acquiring serious dimensions is noise pollution.
have acquiring serious dimensions is noise pollution.

solution:
The correct answer is **'is acquiring serious dimensions is noise pollution.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase in question is ‘**is acquiring serious dimensions was noise pollution.**'
 
• The verb '**was**' in the underlined segment should be replaced with '**is**' to make the sentence grammatically consistent and meaningful.
 
• The correct phrase should be '**is acquiring serious dimensions is noise pollution,**' implying that noise pollution is a new kind of pollution that is currently gaining serious dimensions.
 
• Options 1 and 4 both use '**have been**' and '**have**,' which are incorrect in this context as pollution in the phrase is singular.

Therefore, the correct answer is:** Option 2.**

**Correct Sentence:* ****A new kind of pollution that **is acquiring serious dimensions is noise pollution**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Noise pollution is an emerging environmental issue. It is caused by high levels of noise, often from human activities, that can result in harmful effects on human and animal life.
 
• This question highlights the importance of verb agreement in English grammar, particularly the agreement between a verb and its subject in number and tense.
